patterns.what_worked: The Lead-authorised re-cut of the three stale secret_guard_state pins went green immediately and exposed a real latent crash the old 0-mana default had masked: the paladin filler mirror compared a now-nilable mana value at four sites. Gating them on mana_known fixed a defect that would have thrown on a restricted Forever/Era tick in-client. Mutation M10 and a secret_guard baseline were added, taking the proof to 10/10 and the final full harness to 57 steps / 0 failed.
patterns.what_was_hard: The stale pins encoded the pre-fix behaviour, so re-cutting them required installing the client's C_Secrets predicates and UnitPowerType answer into that suite's fixture to exercise the real H1 probe path rather than weakening the assertion.
